notes: Purchase order types (ST_PR_ORDER_TYPES): number > 0 (next number by the generated key), no duplicate, Arabic or English name required, purchase transaction must be a purchase-invoice type (legacy LOV EFFECT 1 / TRNS_TYPE 1) (APP_RULES3_PR)

row_rules.ST_PR_ORDER_TYPES:
-- legacy WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM / PRE-INSERT: number > 0, no duplicate, a name, purchase transaction from the LOV domain
app_rules3_pr.pr_order_type_row(inserting, :new.serial, :new.name_a, :new.name_e, :new.trns_type_code);

ST_PR_ORDER_TYPES.TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where effect = 1 and trns_type = 1 order by 2
